address: Shop D1, South Gate, The Canton Place, Haifeng Road, Zhujiang New Town, Tianhe, Guangzhou, China Mainland
bio: From the outside, this stylish restaurant looks like a piece of avant-garde art. On the inside, the theatrically lit interior exudes understated luxe. Here, classic Hunanese dishes are given a new spin with haute cuisine precision and artistic plating. Highlights include stir-fried Hunanese dried pork with garlic sprouts and bamboo shoot, and braised goose web and Sri Lankan crab in ginger chili sauce....
